annotations.text:
Options B and C, each in light and dark.

Every artboard has a "dark" switch in the chips above it — flip it to see the same frame in the other mode. The two frames per row show both modes side by side so you can compare without clicking.

In the built app this is one toggle in the user menu, remembered per person, defaulting to the device's setting.

B · Warm Hospitality
Light: cream ground, deep-green accent. Dark: warm charcoal (not black), sage accent — still reads as the brand at night.
Tradeoff: roomier rows mean fewer conversations per screen.

C · Night Shift
Dark is its native mode: high contrast, amber, countdown timers, 44px targets. Light keeps the structure and timers but lets amber recede to a room-number highlight so it isn't loud in a bright lobby.
Tradeoff: the densest chrome — the conversation column is the narrowest of the three.
A · Ops Console — kept for reference, not selected.
